summary: Life Time Group Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a share repurchase from affiliates of Leonard Green, TPG, and Partners Group. The company bought 2,192,500 shares at ~$28.60 each for ~$62.7 million in a private transaction. The repurchase was authorized under a board-approved stock buyback program from February 2026. Mechanics: the deal was a private sale exempt from registration, reducing overhang from large sponsors. What to watch: the company may continue repurchases under its existing program; no premium or discount relative to market was disclosed, so the risk-arb angle is minimal.
